جَثٌّ , so in the S [and L] and other lexicons, but in the K it is implied that it is ↓ جُثٌّ , (TA,) Bees' wax: or any particles, of the wings of the bees, (S, K,) and of their bodies, (S,) intermixed with the honey: (S, K:) [or] the خِرْشَآء of honey; (K;) i. e. the young bees, or the wings, that are upon honey; as in the M and L &c.: (TA:) or the bees that have died in the honey. (IAar, TA.) ―
-b2- Also Dead locusts. (IAar, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
